No accounts, no analytics, no ads and no crash reports. The app only talks to your speaker on the local network and, when checking or resolving a station, to that station\'s server. Your stations are stored only on this phone.

The speaker downloads the stream itself: once you tap a station you can close the app. It\'s controlled with Bose\'s local API (port 8090) and its UPnP player (port 8091). The app only treats a station as playing once the speaker confirms it.

SoundTouch doesn\'t accept https addresses sent directly, but it does follow a redirect to https (verified with a SoundTouch 10). So, for https-only stations, the phone gives it an http address of its own that just says “go to the https one”. Audio goes from the station to the speaker: the phone only steps in at start-up. This test checks it with your speaker.
